code:
docker compose up -d        # start the whole stack
docker compose ps           # status
docker compose logs -f      # all logs, interleaved and labeled
docker compose down         # stop and remove (volumes survive)
description: The four Compose commands that start, inspect, follow, and tear down a stack.

steps.description: `docker compose up -d` starts the whole stack in the background.
`docker compose ps` shows the status of the services.
`docker compose logs -f` follows all logs, interleaved and labeled by service.
`docker compose down` stops and removes the stack. The comment notes the volumes survive, so your data persists.

title: Compose Commands
